title: A Trip to the Market
sentences: Last weekend, Tom went to the market to buy some clothes.
He needed a new jacket because winter was coming soon.
The market was busy and full of colorful stalls.
He found a nice blue jacket at a small shop.
The seller let him try it on before buying.
Tom liked the jacket, so he decided to buy it.
When he got home, he noticed a small hole in it.
He went back to the shop the next day.
The seller was kind and gave him a new jacket instead.
Tom thanked her and left the market feeling happy.
